activity_summary: At Hewlands Bartholomew set you to bind. The ears were short, and the stooks were to stand with ground between them. Dinner was an hour at his call. You bound, and you did not count his crop.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Bound, and did not count the crop.

entities.name: Bartholomew Hathaway
entities.context: Set the work, the stooks, and the hour for dinner.

quotes.speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
quotes.text: Short in the ear. The stooks stand with ground between them

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I'll bind. I will not count your crop for you
